Maya (CSM): Heads-up — KryptonWare renewal ~6w. Usage down ~48% last 30d, embeddings + rerank biggest drop. AE noted a silent NebulaAI POC. Need fast triage.
Jordan (AM): Any obvious trigger? recent deploy or billing change?
Maya (CSM): They rotated API keys last week and paused nightly batch scoring. Several power users inactive.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Quick log check shows surge of 429s on /embed after the key rotation. Snippet: ERROR 429: quota exceeded -> fallback to full compute.
Luca (AE): I'll reach procurement. Can we offer a short Dedicated trial or credits to stall?
Ana (RevOps): We can approve a 10-day trial if engineering applies mitigations and we get a confirmation call.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Low-risk mitigation: enable prefix KV cache + 1.5x concurrency for 72h and turn on debug for 48h. I can push an account override and run a smoke test.
Maya (CSM): Action items: Jordan — export top routes + inactive seat list (EOD). Devon — stage override & smoke (24h). Luca — draft trial terms & procurement note (48h). Maya — schedule a 30m renewal triage with Priya (Dir Data) + Evan (Procurement) + Ana. If no reply in 72h escalate to RevOps.
Jordan (AM): Uploading export now and will post the link.
Maya (CSM): Thanks — reconvene after the smoke test and before we send the exec invite.
